title: 达美靠常旅客：年赚40亿美元，低成本航司还能撑多久？
speaker: George Ferguson

segments.en: Yes, spirits a unique case. It was dealing with issues for a much longer time as we've been discussing here, George.
segments.zh: 精神航空是特例，它的问题由来已久。

segments.en: But some of the pressures that were brought to bear on spirit are shared by a lot of these other carriers. Yeah, it's a very challenged business in the US and so first ultra-low-cost is sort of equated to like a Ryanair-type airline in Europe.
segments.zh: 但精神航空面临的压力，其他航司也有。美国超低成本模式类似欧洲瑞安航空，但挑战更大。

segments.en: It doesn't seem to have taken off as well in the US and lately the dynamic in the market is very challenging, right?
segments.zh: 这种模式在美国似乎不太成功，近期市场动态充满挑战。

segments.en: Because if you look at the big full-service carriers, you look at United and Delta, especially, the way they're running their business right now is they, one, they have these big premium programs where they give their loyal customers, you know, they have a credit card, they buy their dinners and they buy their groceries on that card and the airline sells miles to the credit card company and generates a bunch of revenue on that.
segments.zh: 大型全服务航司如美联航和达美，通过高端会员计划和信用卡合作创造大量收入。

segments.en: And Delta makes some $4 billion or so a year on that. Then they use premium front cabin, extra leg room, all kinds of crazy things to boost revenue.
segments.zh: 达美每年因此赚约40亿美元，还通过高级舱位、腿部空间等提升收入。

segments.en: And remember in the back of all their airplanes, they tell people is a little spirit airlines or a little frontier. They sell those fares, they can tighten those down a bit to be very competitive against spirit and frontier, cover the marginal cost of flying that airplane plus a little bit.
segments.zh: 他们飞机后舱类似迷你精神航空，可压低票价与低成本航司竞争，覆盖边际成本。

segments.en: If they fill the airplane 90, 100%, they get great efficiencies, they've subsidized a bit of the back of the airplane and they're taking spirit and frontier sort of, you know, they're hurting them in the marketplace.
segments.zh: 若客座率90-100%，效率极高，后舱补贴，从而挤压精神航空和边疆航空的市场空间。

segments.en: So in the US, because we don't see this dynamic in Europe and other parts of the world, they don't have the credit card fees that they can count on in other parts of the world in the US, I think this model is getting very challenging.
segments.zh: 美国缺乏欧洲那样的信用卡收入支撑，这种模式在美国愈发艰难。

segments.en: And so I think that we're going to have to see a slim down in those low cost carriers in the US, I think in order to keep them viable.
segments.zh: 因此，美国低成本航司可能需要瘦身才能维持生存。
